changelog: Edit Order now has a Reference Files box. Files already on the order are shown as thumbnails, and you can add more — a photo of the sample, the customer's artwork, an old bill, anything — without creating the order again.
Remove a file with the Remove button. Nothing is actually deleted until you press Save Changes, so a mis-click is undone by simply leaving the page.

Far more file types are accepted now: photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP, WEBP), design files (PDF, CDR, AI, PSD, EPS, INDD, DWG, DXF), documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, CSV), fonts (TTF, OTF) and bundles (ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR).
Anything that could run as a program is still refused, and the screen tells you which file was rejected and why.
